matrix.evidence: Missing campaign/state/event fields hydrate through conservative defaults; transactions, revision checks, rollback, restart, and ordered events pass tests; no SQLite schema migration was needed.
limitations: No production DB was modified; manual backup restore drill was not run.
outstanding_actions: Run the documented restore-to-separate-file exercise before public distribution.

matrix.area: API security and local deployment boundary
matrix.evidence: Current local runner uses loopback and isolated temporary SQLite; validation and generic storage errors are covered; focused source credential scan found no obvious embedded credentials.
tests: API request validation and storage failure tests
limitations: No authentication, authorization, TLS, origin policy, rate/body limits, or per-user save ownership.
outstanding_actions: Keep bound to 127.0.0.1. Add authenticated boundary and operational controls before any public/shared-network use.
